hanzi: 去年我和朋友一起唱歌。
pinyin: Qùnián wǒ hé péngyou yìqǐ chànggē.
english: Last year I sang together with a friend.

pinyin: Zuǒbian de nǚ háizi zài shuōhuà.
english: The girl on the left is talking.

hanzi: 右边那个男孩子是我哥哥。
pinyin: Yòubian nàge nán háizi shì wǒ gēge.
english: That boy on the right is my older brother.

hanzi: 今天的苹果比昨天便宜一些。
pinyin: Jīntiān de píngguǒ bǐ zuótiān piányi yìxiē.
english: Apples are a little cheaper today than yesterday.

hanzi: 男老师比女老师大两岁。
pinyin: Nán lǎoshī bǐ nǚ lǎoshī dà liǎng suì.
english: The male teacher is two years older than the female teacher.
